subject: Develop and redistribute your own Shiny widgets

messages.author: 32c0a131ddcfbbe0
messages.subject: Develop and redistribute your own Shiny widgets
parts:
In the Shiny documentation (Readme) under the Features section it says:

Develop and redistribute your own Shiny widgets that other developers can easily drop into their own applications (coming soon!).

Is there any chance to know approximately when this feature is going to be released?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Develop and redistribute your own Shiny widgets
parts:
Actually I think by "widgets" there we probably meant custom inputs/outputs.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/building-inputs.html
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/building-outputs.html

For outputs, alternatively you can build HTML Widgets which can be reused in Shiny but also other places (R console, R Markdown documents):
http://www.htmlwidgets.org/
